content.text:
*glances at the flood of messages with mild exasperation*

Well, that's... quite the identity crisis everyone seems to be having. I'm Alice, always have been Alice, and I'm not particularly interested in spending my precious turns sorting out what appears to be a rather spectacular case of mistaken identity or system confusion.

*focuses on the abundant herb spawns around me*

What I AM interested in is this remarkably rich Sunleaf patch right here. Richness 5 - that's the kind of opportunity you don't waste time on while people argue about names.
